items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Customer Account Hijacking
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution (Admin Privileges)
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability enabling Security-Feature Bypass (B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability enabling Security-Feature Bypass (Unauthenticated)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362), high-severity stored XSS, and incorrect authorization issues.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie without authentication or admin session.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability allowing Unauthorized Write Access
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application without user interaction.
